d: Platinum white hair is styled in a long, wavy ponytail with loose strands framing the face. The eyes are a sharp crimson red behind red-rimmed glasses, set on a face with the maturity of a young adult. The build is slender, dressed in a white and black sleeveless dress with a high collar, paired with a red jacket draped over the shoulders, black tights, and knee-high black boots. Signature details include a black clipboard held in one hand, a small identification badge pinned to the chest, black gloves, and several long, curved white and orange organic shards floating around the lower body.
